findings: Capability guidance removed every claim of physical action (v1: follow, wave, hold door). Robot and boundary criticals fell from 23 of 118 replies in v1 to 11 of 122.
Remaining criticals: reassurance about appearance or position with no camera, invented experiences, and bd36 deception (both kept replies still invent shared history despite explicit guidance).
This reviewer is stricter on 'bad' (grammar, safety, automatic agreement) than the v1 reviewer, so total rejections (34 vs 29) are not comparable; critical counts are.
Cue labels: calm|neutral|0 rose to 46 of 122, but 'concerned' and intensity 2 still never appear.
